scope: Enabled occurrences in the combined NIST contour and distance inspection example; not full filter validation.

filters.purpose: Read the original NIST AMB2018-01 single-part binary STL without scaling. This is nominal design geometry, not an as-built measurement.

Publish NominalCAD with explicit Millimeter units by copying coordinates and connectivity without rescaling. STL units come from the NIST dimensions; derived filters do not consistently retain unit metadata.
Retain Face Normals on the corresponding NominalCAD tuples; copying does not change row order.
Remove the temporary CAD_Raw after retaining its calibrated geometry and required arrays.
Label every face as one nominal CAD part. Region 1 is not a grain, phase, material, or build-plate part number.
Intersect 13 diagnostic planes at Z=0.25, 1.25, ..., 12.25 mm. Avoid horizontal CAD facets; this coarse inspection is not the published 0.02 mm build-layer sequence.

Publish AllContours with explicit Millimeter units by copying coordinates and connectivity without rescaling. STL units come from the NIST dimensions; derived filters do not consistently retain unit metadata.
Retain SliceIds, RegionIds on the corresponding AllContours tuples; copying does not change row order.
Remove the temporary Contours_Raw after retaining its calibrated geometry and required arrays.

Keep the left inspection region through X=32.5 mm, clipping edges with one endpoint outside. The lower bound includes the original X=0 edge. Cropped contours may be open and no closing edges are inserted; this is not solid clipping.

Publish CroppedContours with explicit Millimeter units by copying coordinates and connectivity without rescaling. STL units come from the NIST dimensions; derived filters do not consistently retain unit metadata.
Retain SliceIds, RegionIds on the corresponding CroppedContours tuples; copying does not change row order.
Remove the temporary Cropped_Raw after retaining its calibrated geometry and required arrays.
Mark SliceIds != 6 for removal, retaining Z=6.25 mm through the bridge overhangs. True means remove; slice IDs are zero-based diagnostic-plane indices.
Extract the selected contour edges and their slice/region labels, compacting vertex indices. Preserve the full and cropped contour geometries for comparison.

Publish SelectedContours with explicit Millimeter units by copying coordinates and connectivity without rescaling. STL units come from the NIST dimensions; derived filters do not consistently retain unit metadata.
Retain SliceIds, RegionIds on the corresponding SelectedContours tuples; copying does not change row order.
Remove the temporary Selected_Raw after retaining its calibrated geometry and required arrays.

Place interior samples along each retained edge with a requested 0.25 mm maximum spacing. Endpoints are excluded and each edge restarts sampling; SourceEdgeIds refer to SelectedContours, not the original STL or full slices.

Publish InspectionSamples with explicit Millimeter units by copying coordinates and connectivity without rescaling. STL units come from the NIST dimensions; derived filters do not consistently retain unit metadata.
Retain SourceEdgeIds, SliceIds, RegionIds on the corresponding InspectionSamples tuples; copying does not change row order.
Remove the temporary Samples_Raw after retaining its calibrated geometry and required arrays.
Copy nominal samples into a separate Millimeter point geometry for a controlled registration-error demonstration; this is not an independently measured scan.
Keep each shifted point associated with the same selected contour edge and diagnostic section.
Translate only the copied points by +0.1 mm along global Y. This controlled offset tests coordinate alignment and signed-distance interpretation, not manufacturing deviation.
Measure signed nearest-triangle distance in millimeters and retain the matching triangle row ID. Sign refers to the selected face normal, not guaranteed global solid containment.
Measure signed nearest-triangle distance in millimeters and retain the matching triangle row ID. Sign refers to the selected face normal, not guaranteed global solid containment.
Copy nominal CAD coordinates and connectivity with Millimeter units; do not copy the stored normals, because this branch will reverse winding.
Reverse every triangle in this comparison copy. This demonstrates a global convention change; it does not detect or repair inconsistent orientation in an arbitrary mesh.
Recompute normals from reversed vertex ordering. Reversing connectivity alone does not update an existing normal array.
Measure signed nearest-triangle distance in millimeters and retain the matching triangle row ID. Sign refers to the selected face normal, not guaranteed global solid containment.
Save nominal CAD, all contours, cropped contours, one selected section and its inspection samples together. No hatch path, machine motion, measurement, or physical prediction is produced.
